title.zh: Pirate Chain确认近日遭攻击，代币供应量增发约20%
title.en: Pirate Chain确认近日遭攻击，代币供应量增发约20%

current_state.zh: Pirate Chain 已进入修复阶段：强制升级 v6.0.14 已发布，相关验证漏洞已修复，链已回滚至区块 4,176,944 以清除伪造 ARRR 并恢复供应上限；旧版本运营方被要求立即升级。
current_state.en: Pirate Chain is in remediation: mandatory v6.0.14 has been released, the validation vulnerabilities are fixed, and the chain has been rolled back to block 4,176,944 to purge forged ARRR and restore the supply cap; old-version operators are required to upgrade immediately.

updates.title_zh: Pirate Chain确认近日遭攻击，代币供应量增发约20%
updates.title_en: Pirate Chain确认近日遭攻击，代币供应量增发约20%
updates.what_changed_zh: Pirate Chain 确认了一个交易验证漏洞，该漏洞产生了约 3980 万枚未经授权的 ARRR（约占供应量的 20%），促使 dPoW 运营者暂停公证，团队则要求交易所和矿池暂停运营，同时制定恢复计划。
updates.what_changed_en: Pirate Chain confirmed a transaction-validation vulnerability that created roughly 39.8 million unauthorized ARRR (about 20% of supply), prompting dPoW operators to pause notarization and the team to ask exchanges and mining pools to suspend operations while a recovery plan is drawn up.
updates.current_state_zh: Pirate Chain 确认了一个交易验证漏洞，该漏洞产生了约 3980 万枚未经授权的 ARRR（约占供应量的 20%），促使 dPoW 运营者暂停公证，团队则要求交易所和矿池暂停运营，同时制定恢复计划。

updates.title_zh: 【Pirate Chain 拟强制升级至 v6.0.14 版本，完成链回滚以消除约 3982 万枚伪造 ARRR】
updates.title_en: 【Pirate Chain 拟强制升级至 v6.0.14 版本，完成链回滚以消除约 3982 万枚伪造 ARRR】
updates.what_changed_zh: Pirate Chain 发布强制升级 v6.0.14，并要求旧版本用户、节点、矿工、矿池、交易所及服务商升级；社区通过共识将链回滚至区块 4,176,944，以移除约 3982 万枚伪造 ARRR 并恢复 2 亿枚供应上限。
updates.what_changed_en: Pirate Chain released mandatory v6.0.14, requiring old-version users, nodes, miners, pools, exchanges and service providers to upgrade; by community consensus the chain was rolled back to block 4,176,944 to remove about 39.82 million forged ARRR and restore the 200 million supply cap.
updates.current_state_zh: Pirate Chain 已进入修复阶段：强制升级 v6.0.14 已发布，相关验证漏洞已修复，链已回滚至区块 4,176,944 以清除伪造 ARRR 并恢复供应上限；旧版本运营方被要求立即升级。
updates.current_state_en: Pirate Chain is in remediation: mandatory v6.0.14 has been released, the validation vulnerabilities are fixed, and the chain has been rolled back to block 4,176,944 to purge forged ARRR and restore the supply cap; old-version operators are required to upgrade immediately.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Pirate Chain issued a mandatory v6.0.14 upgrade and rolled the chain back to block 4,176,944 to purge ~39.82 million forged ARRR created through two validation vulnerabilities on October 14, restoring the 200 million supply cap.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Pirate Chain issued a mandatory v6.0.14 upgrade and rolled the chain back to block 4,176,944 to purge ~39.82 million forged ARRR created through two validation vulnerabilities on October 14, restoring the 200 million supply cap.
